name: Blur echo statement card
looks: A short eyebrow label and a two-line statement, a plain first line and a softer italic second line, fade and rise into a flat gradient field, with the exact art that proves the line sitting enlarged and heavily blurred behind the text as a soft colour echo. The card holds, then hard-cuts to the next beat's label, lines and echo together.
build: Eyebrow label fades in first (~0.15s); first line rises 6-8px on power2.out; second italic line follows after a short pause at lower opacity; background is the same raster scaled 1.15-1.3x with blur(40-60px) and a gradient wash, cross-fading to the next beat's source on the cut.
sound: A soft intake on the label, a light rise under each line landing, silence held through the hold.
prompt: Fade in a short eyebrow label and a two-line statement, a plain line then a softer italic line, over a flat gradient field with the proving art enlarged and heavily blurred behind the text as a colour echo. Hold, then hard-cut straight into the next beat's label, lines and echoed art together.
